panel_description_zh: 中近景平视（妻子反打视角），李斌坐在床上头微抬看妻子方向（眼半睁）；一只手臂仍搭在被子上；头发更乱（揉了一下）；嘴半张着（仍在说话）；人物位置在画面下半部上方留白；背景窗帘已开窗外城市轮廓虚化。
prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions, muted warm-cool palette. Eye-level medium close-up reverse shot from the wife's standing position looking at the husband sitting on the bed. A 30-something East Asian Chinese man sitting upright on the guest-bed, head tilted slightly up looking toward camera-left (the wife's direction). One arm still resting on the duvet which has been pulled down to his chest. Short black hair even messier than before — he has just rubbed it with his hand in the habitual wake-up gesture. Eyes only half-open with gaze unfocused, mouth half-open still mid-speech, two-to-three-day stubble shadow visible. Loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt. The figure sits in the lower half of the frame with significant empty space above his head. Background soft-focus: opened curtain with the morning cityscape blurred beyond. Cool blue-grey bedroom interior with warm morning sunlight from the right back-lighting his head. Mood: the effort of speaking, the body trying to rise against the posture default of collapse. Text watermark 'P04-PN02' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: anime proportions, fully open alert eyes, smiling, tears, bright flat lighting, wife visible in frame, decorative bedroom art, soft romantic mood, well-groomed hair, second character
